tagline: A causeway and drawbridge carry Manatee Avenue across bay waters
intro: The Palma Sola Scenic Highway carries Manatee Avenue West across Palma Sola Bay and the inland waterway, linking the mainland with Anna Maria Island. The Florida Scenic Highways program designated it on May 28, 2004, and lists a six-mile byway. The program highlights recreational areas planted with native vegetation and describes the corridor as park-like, with picnic areas beside opportunities for fishing and sailing. Its main segment follows SR 64 between 75th Street West and East Bay Drive. The causeway’s waterside uses include water skiing and jet skiing as well as fishing and sailing. At the island end, the corridor connects with the Bradenton Beach Scenic Highway to the south.

The present crossing took shape in 1957, when the Palma Sola Causeway and Anna Maria Island Bridge extended SR 64 west from Bradenton through Perico Island. The new bridge gave Anna Maria Island its second mainland connection, following the Cortez Bridge farther south. Before the extension, Perico Island’s road access followed a route from 9th Avenue North along what is now Spoonbill Trail.

Driving east from the island end at East Bay Drive, leave Holmes Beach on Manatee Avenue and cross Anna Maria Sound to Perico Island. Continue across Palma Sola Causeway to the mainland, ending the byway at 75th Street West.

moments.title: Holmes Beach
moments.text: John E. Holmes Sr. returned after World War II to develop a planned community here, before the 1957 bridge brought SR 64 to the island. In 1948, parts of On an Island with You were filmed here, with a cast that included Esther Williams, Jimmy Durante and Cyd Charisse. The town incorporated on March 13, 1950, after a vote of 46 in favor, 13 against and one abstention. Palm City and Mid-Island Beach were among the alternative names considered. The city occupies the middle of Anna Maria Island, with the city of Anna Maria to the north and Bradenton Beach to the south.

moments.title: Anna Maria Island Bridge
moments.text: The Anna Maria Island Bridge is a double-leaf bascule bridge, built in 1957 with the Palma Sola Causeway. Together they carried SR 64 west to Anna Maria Island and added a second mainland connection after the Cortez Bridge. The crossing on Manatee Avenue leads over Anna Maria Sound between Holmes Beach and Perico Island. The two mainland bridges serve different island communities: SR 64 enters Holmes Beach, while the Cortez Bridge carries SR 684 into Bradenton Beach. Before the 1957 extension, Perico Island had road access from 9th Avenue North along the route of present-day Spoonbill Trail.

moments.title: Palma Sola Causeway
moments.text: Picnic areas and native landscaping make the causeway part of the byway’s recreation corridor. Florida Scenic Highways identifies fishing, sailing, water skiing and jet skiing along its length. The causeway opened as part of the 1957 extension of SR 64 to Perico and Anna Maria islands. Eastbound traffic crosses from Perico Island toward the mainland, where SR 64 becomes a divided road.
moments.notice: Native vegetation landscapes the corridor’s recreational areas.
